llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent and low‑risk because it's instruction‑only and requests no credentials. Before using: (1) don't feed it sensitive personal data (PII) you don't want processed; (2) treat its compliance guidance as advisory — it is not a substitute for legal or regulatory review (ANVISA/INMETRO/CDC/CONAR issues); (3) test outputs on sample listings to verify platform limits and required disclosures (e.g., #publi), and confirm that any claims have evidence you can cite; (4) if you need automation that posts directly to marketplaces or ad platforms, prefer a skill that explicitly requests the relevant API credentials and documents where data is sent. Overall, it’s coherent for humanizing e‑commerce copy but verify content for regulatory/accuracy needs before publishing.
